notes.title: Demo v1.2 - Controller support, auto attack, auto aim
notes.content:
Demo v1.2 is not Live!

This version adds the following:
- Controller support
- Auto attack
- Auto aim
- Expanded the rune system to include some normal type runes
- Various bug fixes

Now the demo: 
- Provides a more accurate view of the game 
- Aligns with roguelike standard expected features :)
